title: Suspicious Staches
description: Allows players to hide items in suspicious blocks by placing empty suspicious blocks on them!
body:
Allows players to hide items in suspicious blocks by placing empty suspicious blocks on them!

The only way to get those blocks is to find either suspicious sand or gravel in your world and have it drop as an item. This can be done by keeping it as a falling block in either a bubble column or cobwebs for one minute.
Then place the suspicious block on any item to add it as it's brushing loot.

**Warning**: The item will get deleted if the block gets destroyed - that includes turning it back into the item form!
